body_revisions.scope: Run native PyTorch QNNPACK dynamic INT8 with a fixed input row and vary only its batch partner.
body_revisions.observation: An outlier batch changed the target class from 1 to 0. Splitting the same inputs restored the class, and only the passing input shapes were timed. Evidence is single-threaded CPU forward, not service latency.
